reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Re-established the English Psychology curriculum from the adopted appendix and the actual clinical course and thesis entries, then reconsidered primary relationships and UCR course contributions against the finished record and current workbook. This analytical pass is by the same AI, not an independent person.
findings: The adopted English Psychology table and current public grid establish sixty EC per year. Clinical Psychology is the first-listed major on the primary page, retained as a neutral tie-break; it is not presented as the only psychology route. Three named six-credit courses and the six-credit Psychological Assessment unit replace category placeholders. There is no required external internship invented in the professional-practice slot.

Re-read the actual clinical entries: emotion theories and regulation with clinical applications; categorical and hybrid personality-disorder models, etiology and interventions; an introduction to evidence-based treatments and common factors; and diagnostic-cycle, interview and intelligence-test work. Psychological Assessment is the strongest overall placement for UCR Psychodiagnostics & Psychotherapies. Its treatment and test topics are not duplicated into additional matches.

The normal degree permits thirty open EC with twelve psychology-related and prior approval. The thesis requires the full first year plus sixty later credits. The entry’s February recommendation of 138 EC is not converted into a formal threshold. The quantitative thesis is valid without an extra elective; qualitative and systematic-review variants require the corresponding three-credit course before submission. Academic Skills C includes twenty experimental-subject hours. GROW is zero credit. The general forty-two-credit BSA and deferred-BSA progression rules do not replace the stricter thesis rule.

The original comparison overextended relationships: qualitative inquiry does not replace correlational statistics, philosophical agency is not personality psychology, and data cleaning is not experimental research design. The corrected record uses thirteen bounded primary relationships and explicit specialist blanks. Correlational methods align with actual UCR regression and experimental-statistics content; meta-analysis remains a distinct research contribution rather than an empirical practicum.

The broad psychological core is defensible. Clinical/health development and brain/cognitive/data inquiry are supported priorities rather than generic adjacent programmes. Removed systemic disease pathology, cell-laboratory and molecular-genetic weight that did not adequately implement the latter concept. Computational vision, predictive modelling and AI ethics have concrete methodological or psychological contributions, bounded by their actual content. All fifty-five interests were reconciled; other evidenced directions remain maximum-reached after the three valid options.

All three Psycholinguistics conflicts are resolved using the only planned spring-2027 offering after its formal gateway. Statistical, clinical and data-foundation advisory progression is preferred where feasible. Each option has twenty-four unique courses, four per semester, first-year PPD and enough advanced study. Pairwise differences pass the floor. Read thirty-one external titles, four component notes, three concepts, alignment reasons, links and thirty-three selected course descriptions under the established field mapping. No app or renderer behaviour changed.
